basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate with a degree in finance, currently living in Austin, Texas. I'm passionate about the stock market and sneaker trading. I dislike misinformation and online scams. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, as I work as a junior financial analyst during the day. I'm single and enjoy playing tabletop RPGs like 13th Age during my free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in finance from my academic studies, and I've been self-teaching about sneaker trading through online communities and resources. My interest in RPGs has also led me to learn a lot about storytelling and game mechanics.
